Subject: Cutting alert noise for your engineering team

Hi [First Name],

- **There's a 14-day trial**, so you can connect your logs and judge the results on your own data.
- **30 customers** already use us for day-to-day monitoring.

If your team is spending too much time sorting real issues from false alarms, I think this is worth a quick look.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call next week to see whether it fits your stack? If the timing isn't right, I'm happy to send a short overview you can review whenever it suits you.
